title: Santalum album cream for medicinal use
intro: Santalum album cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the oil extracted from the wood of the sandalwood tree, *Santalum album*. This cream is traditionally used in herbalism for its calming and soothing properties. It is often applied to the skin to alleviate stress, anxiety, and skin irritations. The fragrance of the cream is believed to have a grounding and mood-enhancing effect. It is also used in aromatherapy and as a natural remedy for promoting relaxation and emotional balance.
